Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini scored a goal on six shots and added two PIM in Friday's 4-1 loss to the Wild.
Celebrini scored a power-play goal on five shots, added four PIM and logged three hits in Wednesday's 7-2 loss to the Kings.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard scored a power-play goal on three shots, dished an assist and added two PIM in Thursday's 5-4 loss to the Ducks.
Bouchard scored a goal and added a power-play assist in Tuesday's 4-3 shootout loss to the Devils.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider recorded two assists in Monday's 5-3 win over the Panthers.
Seider notched two assists, two shots on goal, four hits and four blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes recorded two assists, six shots on goal and a plus-2 rating in Thursday's 5-4 overtime win over the Blues.
Hughes scored twice on five shots, dished an assist and blocked three shots in Tuesday's 4-3 shootout win over the Oilers.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier scored a goal on four shots and went plus-2 in Friday's 5-3 win over the Flames.
Gauthier scored a goal and added an assist, both on the power play, in Thursday's 5-4 win over the Oilers.

Dylan Guenther.summary: Guenther scored a goal in Tuesday's 3-2 win over Toronto.
Guenther scored a power-play goal on three shots in Saturday's 5-4 overtime win over the Lightning.

Jakob Chychrun.summary: Chychrun tallied a power-play goal, picked up an assist and launched five shots on net in Tuesday's 6-5 loss to Dallas.
Chychrun notched two assists, four shots on goal and five blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 overtime win over the Sabres.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored a goal on three shots in Saturday's 4-3 win over the Panthers.
Tuch scored a goal, added two hits and blocked two shots in Thursday's 4-3 win over the Predators.

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman turned aside 21 shots in regulation and overtime and all three shootout attempts he faced in Monday's 3-2 win over the Golden Knights.
Swayman will start Monday's home game against the Golden Knights, Adam Pellerin of NESN reports.
Jeremy Swayman.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Adam Pellerin (NESN)

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke (upper body) is expected to play against Buffalo on Saturday, per Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site.
Brandt Clarke.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Zach Dooley (Kings')

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke (upper body) won't return to Thursday's game versus the Senators.

Tom Wilson.summary: Wilson scored an empty-net goal on three shots in Friday's 3-1 win over the Rangers. He also added three hits.
Wilson scored a goal on two shots, added two assists, logged two hits, blocked two shots and went plus-3 in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Penguins.

Connor Bedard.summary: Bedard scored a goal, dished an assist, added two hits and blocked two shots in Saturday's 9-2 loss to the Hurricanes.
Bedard picked up two assists while adding four shots on net, two hits, two PIM and a plus-1 rating in Wednesday's 5-3 loss to the Panthers.

Connor Hellebuyck.summary: Hellebuyck stopped 28 of 32 shots in Thursday's 5-4 overtime win over the Blues.
Hellebuyck was the first goalie off during Thursday's morning skate, Mike Morreale of NHL.com reports, indicating that he'll draw the home start against the Blues.
Connor Hellebuyck.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Mike Morreale (NHL.com)

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev scored a power-play goal on four shots in Thursday's 3-2 win over the Flyers.
Dorofeyev scored a goal in Sunday's 4-1 loss to the Oilers.

Mark Stone.summary: Stone scored a power-play goal in Monday's 3-2 shootout loss to the Bruins.
Stone scored a power-play goal, added four hits and went minus-2 in Friday's 5-2 loss to the Devils.

Justin Faulk.summary: Faulk scored a power-play goal and added an even-strength assist in Monday's 5-3 win over the Panthers.
Faulk scored a power-play goal on four shots, added two blocked shots and logged two PIM in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.

Gavin McKenna.summary: McKenna scored a goal Saturday in a 4-2 loss to Montreal.
McKenna scored two power-play goals, dished an assist and added two PIM in Wednesday's 5-4 loss to the Kraken.

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson Ek scored a goal on four shots, added two PIM, blocked two shots and went plus-2 in Tuesday's 4-2 win over the Flyers.
Eriksson Ek recorded two assists, including one on the power play, and fired three shots on goal in Sunday's 5-1 win over the Capitals.

Mikael Granlund.summary: Granlund had two assists, including one on the power play, and two blocked shots in Friday's 5-3 win over the Flames.
Granlund scored a power-play goal and added two assists in Tuesday's 5-4 win over the Canucks.

Mackenzie Blackwood.summary: Blackwood posted a 27-save shutout in Saturday's 4-0 win over the Red Wings.
Blackwood will defend the home crease in Saturday's game against the Red Wings, per Aarif Deen of Colorado Hockey Now.
Mackenzie Blackwood.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Aarif Deen (Colorado Hockey Now.)

Simon Edvinsson.summary: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
Edvinsson, who is a restricted free agent, has returned to Sweden to resume his training, per Andreas III Johnsson of Goteborgs-Posten on Wednesday.
Simon Edvinsson.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Andreas III Johnsson (Goteborgs-Posten)

Devon Levi.summary: Levi stopped 20 of 22 shots in Saturday's 4-2 win over the Canucks.
Levi (lower body) will defend the home crease in Saturday's clash against the Canucks, per Janson Duench of The Athletic.
Devon Levi.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Janson Duench (The Athletic.)

Charle-Edouard D'Astous.summary: D'Astous scored a goal and added two assists in a 4-3 overtime win over the Wild on Saturday.
D'Astois scored a goal on three shots, dished a power-play assist, added two PIM, levied five hits, blocked three shots in and went plus-2 in Friday's 6-3 loss to the Avalanche.

Jack Quinn.summary: Quinn scored a goal on three shots, added an assist and went plus-3 in Friday's 5-2 win over the Blue Jackets.
Quinn scored a power-play goal on two shots and added a power-play assist in Saturday's 3-2 win over the Kings.
